sources.title: Models - STRATUS X1
sources.snippet: The /v1/models endpoint returns all 2,050+ model combinations dynamically. The list is refreshed at startup from OpenRouter's catalog, so your code always works with the latest available models without hardcoding.

sources.title: Nemotron Labs Teacher General Reasoning: 550B open weights
sources.snippet: NVIDIA open-sourced the Nemotron Labs General Reasoning teacher — a 550B-A55B reasoning model from the Nemotron 3 Ultra MOPD pipeline. Specs and caveats.
